title: Cisco Nexus 3000 Series NX-OS Release Notes, Release 10.3(1)F

observations.description: PVLAN SDK resource FULL error -6 Symptoms: Problem is only seen when community vlan is converted to primary vlan in certain sequence Workarounds: Delete all the VLANs involved in the configuration and reconfigure.

Egress RACL on port-channel subinterface is not getting programmed on Nexus 3548 Symptoms: Upon application of RACL in Egress direction on Nexus 3548 port-channel sub-interface, the ACL entries are not getting programmed into hardware. Workarounds: None
